svg.text: Live public schema snapshot • 20 application tables • 204 columns • 24 foreign keys • read-only inspection
Foreign-key rows name their referenced table and column; full connectors are in the editable .drawio source.
PK = primary key • FK = foreign key • NULL = nullable. The internal flyway_schema_history table is omitted.
This diagram reflects tables currently present in Supabase public schema; locally defined but absent migrations are not shown.
Fields without a database foreign key (for example users.auth_user_id and polymorphic user_reviews.item_id) are shown without inferred relationships.
